# Acknowledgement precedes explanation

> Acknowledgement precedes explanation, always, with no exception for being right.


## The heuristic

**Acknowledgement precedes explanation, always, with no exception for being right.**


_Why:_ Being right is the condition under which this rule is broken, and it is the condition under which it matters most. The customer is not weighing the explanation on its merits while they still believe we have not registered what happened to them.
